name: AK32B - Plug-In Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, HCHO, Temperature, Humidity), Formaldehyde Detector, Mains Powered
highlights: The Two Readings a Bedroom Needs — Overnight CO₂ build-up and long-term formaldehyde off-gassing are the two things a closed sleeping room gets wrong. This covers both and nothing else.
Continuous, Not Sampled — A plug-in monitor sees the 4 a.m. peak that a handheld unit only ever hears about second-hand.
Lowest Entry Price in the Plug-In Range — Semiconductor sensing on both gas channels keeps the unit cost down for multi-room fit-outs.
110–240 V, No Battery to Replace — Mains-powered with US or EU pins.
120 Per Carton — Same enclosure and packing as every AK32 — mix any combination of sensor variants on one pallet.
